note: regenerate with: falco_rule_lab.py casegen --rules FILE --rule NAME

cases.label: positive: evt.type=execve, proc.name=setcap
cases.why: constructed by satisfying every positive clause

cases.label: excluded: proc.pname in (dnf, dnf-automatic, rpm, rpmkey, yum, 75-system-updat, rhsmcertd-worke, rh…
cases.why: satisfies a negated clause, so the rule must stay quiet

cases.label: excluded: evt.num = 0
cases.why: satisfies a negated clause, so the rule must stay quiet

cases.label: second listed value: evt.type=execveat
cases.why: every value in an `in` list must be accepted, not just the first

cases.label: near miss: proc.name=setcap-near-miss
cases.why: one character off the value proc.name must match

cases.label: wrong event type: evt.type=open
cases.why: the event-type gate must reject non-exec events
